title: My New Wife's Fake Smile
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: An Edo-period comedy about a newly married samurai couple in an arranged match. The insecure husband, Soujiro, a second son, reads his wife Chiyo's polite smile as unhappiness and resolves to deserve her, while Chiyo is in fact smitten and hides her attraction for propriety's sake (TOKYOPOP blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates).
life_message: A marriage begun by arrangement can grow into devoted, mutual love when each spouse tries to be worthy of the other.
